Wecker} \maketitle egin{abstract} We study widgets. \end{abstract}` | | 14.2 | Title block with affiliations and keywords | Write a paper's title block with two authors, each with a university affiliation, and a list of keywords. | ` itle{On Widgets} \author{A. Smith hanks{Univ. of X} \and B. Jones hanks{Univ. of Y}} \maketitle \keywords{widgets, gadgets}` | | 14.3 | Theorem and proof | Write a short mathematical passage with a numbered theorem followed by its proof, ending with an end-of-proof mark. | ` egin{theorem} There are infinitely many primes. \end{theorem} egin{proof} Suppose not... contradiction. \end{proof}` | | 14.4 | Numbered definition | Write a numbered definition of a prime number, set apart from the surrounding text the way math books do. | ` egin{definition} A \emph{prime} is an integer $p>1$ whose only positive divisors are $1$ and $p$. \end{definition}` | | 14.5 | Epigraph | Write the opening of a chapter with a short epigraph quotation and its attribution, set apart before the first paragraph. | `\chapter{Beginnings} \epigraph{All models are wrong.}{George Box} The first paragraph starts here.` | | 14.6 | Pull quote | Write a paragraph of an article and a pull quote that repeats a striking line from it in larger type. | `The city never slept, and neither did we. > [!quote] The city never slept, and neither did we.` | | 14.7 | Framed box | Write a paragraph followed by a short piece of text inside a framed box. | `Here is some text. egin{tcolorbox} Important note. \end{tcolorbox}` | | 14.8 | Algorithm in pseudocode | Write a short algorithm in numbered pseudocode with the caption 'Binary search'. | ` egin{algorithm}\caption{Binary search} egin{algorithmic}[1] \State $lo \gets 0$, $hi \gets n-1$ \While{$lo \le hi$} ... \EndWhile \end{algorithmic} \end{algorithm}` | | 14.9 | Subfigures | Write a passage with two images shown side by side, each with its own sub-caption (a) and (b), and one overall caption. | ` egin{figure} egin{subfigure}{.5 extwidth}\includegraphics{a.png}\caption{Before}\end{subfigure} egin{subfigure}{.5 extwidth}\includegraphics{b.png}\caption{After}\end{subfigure} \caption{Comparison} \end{figure}` | | 14.10 | Reference to a page number | Write a sentence that refers to the page number where the section called Results begins, so the number updates automatically. | `See the results on page~\pageref{sec:results}.` | | 14.11 | List of figures | Write a short document outline that includes an automatically generated list of figures. | ` ableofcontents \listoffigures \section{Intro} \section{Method}` | | 14.12 | Appendix | Write a short document with two main sections followed by an appendix labeled with a letter. | `\section{Intro} \section{Method} \appendix \section{Extra Data}` | | 14.13 | Acronyms spelled out on first use | Write two sentences that use the acronym API, so that its first use is spelled out automatically and it appears in a generated list of acronyms. | ` ewacronym{api}{API}{Application Programming Interface} The \gls{api} is simple. We call the \gls{api} twice. \printglossary[type=acronym]` | | 14.14 | Units and quantities | Write a sentence giving a speed of 3.5 × 10^8 meters per second and a temperature of 21 degrees Celsius, with the units typeset correctly. | `Light moves at \SI{3.5e8}{\metre\per\second} at \SI{21}{\celsius}.` | | 14.15 | Chemical equation | Write the balanced chemical equation for burning methane, typeset as chemistry. | `\ce{CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O}` | | 14.16 | Margin to-do note | Write a paragraph with an editorial to-do note attached to it, shown in the margin. | `The results are promising. odo{Add citation here}` | | 14.17 | Line numbers for review | Write a short paragraph set up so that the printed version shows line numbers in the margin for reviewers. | `\usepackage{lineno} \linenumbers This paragraph is numbered for review.` | | 14.18 | Drop cap | Write the first paragraph of a story with its first letter set as a large drop cap. | `\lettrine{O}{nce} upon a time there was a widget.` | | 14.19 | Hyphenation hints | Write a sentence containing the word electroencephalography, marking the places where it may be hyphenated. | `We used elec\-tro\-en\-ceph\-a\-log\-ra\-phy daily.` | | 14.20 | Numbered paragraphs | Write three paragraphs of a contract that are numbered 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3 automatically. | `\section{Terms} egin{enumerate}[label= hesection.\arabic*] \item Party A agrees... \item Party B agrees... \item Both parties... \end{enumerate}` | | 14.21 | Colored text | Write a sentence where the word 'blocked' is shown in red text. | `The port is extcolor{red}{blocked}.` | | 14.22 | Subtext line | Write a heading followed by a line of small, muted subtext under it. | `# Release Notes Last updated October 2026` | | 14.23 | Inline badge | Write a sentence ending with a small colored badge that reads 'beta'. | `Try the new editor beta` | | 14.24 | Inline data fields | Write a note about a book that includes a rating of 5 and a genre of mystery as data fields a query tool could read. | `Finished *Gone Girl* last night. rating:: 5 genre:: mystery` | | 14.25 | Key-value list | Write a short list of facts about a person (name, year born, occupation) that should display as aligned key-value pairs. | ` egin{description} \item[Name] Ada Lovelace \item[Born] 1815 \item[Occupation] Mathematician \end{description}` | | 14.26 | Side-brace grouping | Write three related lines grouped together by a large curly brace with a label beside it. | `$\left. egin{array}{l} x+y=1 \ x-y=3 \ 2x=4 \end{array} ight\} ext{system}$` | | 14.27 | Table formula | Write a small table of expenses whose total row is computed by a formula. | `\| Item \| Cost \| \|---\|---\| \| Rent \| 1200 \| \| Food \| 400 \| \| Total \| =sum(B2:B3) \|` | | 14.28 | Callout on one list item | Write a bulleted list where one item is highlighted as a warning by a marker at the start of that item. | `- Install deps - ⚠️ Do not run as root - Start server` | | 14.29 | Note template | Write a daily-note template that inserts today's date and the note's title automatically when a note is created. | `# {{title}} Date: {{date:YYYY-MM-DD}} ## Notes` | | 14.30 | Inline icon | Write a sentence with a small heart icon from an icon set shown inline. | `Made with aHeart{} by the team.` |
